description: A flowchart diagram file (flowchart_en.eddx from the EdrawMax template library) is already open in Wondershare EdrawMax. The diagram uses the default color scheme. Your task is: (1) Click on the 'Design' tab in the top menu bar to open the Design panel. (2) In the Design panel, click the 'Color' dropdown button to open the color themes panel. (3) Select the 'Warm' color theme by clicking on its thumbnail (it is an orange/yellow-toned warm-color theme in the bottom row of the themes panel). (4) Save the themed diagram using File > Save As (or press Ctrl+Shift+S), navigate to the home folder (/home/ga/), type the filename 'themed_flowchart.eddx' in the filename field, and click Save. Note: if an account login dialog appears when EdrawMax opens, close it with the X button in the dialog's top-right corner before proceeding.
